process_topology.notes: Waitress serves one coordinator process; GenerationManager starts one spawned model worker with WORKER_ID=tpu-0. Automatic worker restart is existing lifecycle behavior and is outside the G7 live path.

authentication.restart_secret: X-Restart-Secret plus normal API authentication for POST /restart

startup.coordinator: Config -> GenerationManager -> Runtime -> create_app -> manager.start_async -> Waitress serve
startup.model_initialization: spawned model_worker_main imports JAX/Keras/KerasHub, builds distribution, constructs Gemma4TPUEngine, calls engine.load once, emits worker_ready
startup.readiness: manager.health() reports ready only for one ready/busy worker with expected device_count

request_call_paths.text: HTTP JSON -> parse_generate_payload -> GenerationManager.submit -> task_queue -> model_worker_main -> engine.generate_text -> JobStore
request_call_paths.image: HTTP JSON/multipart -> parse_image_payload or parse_image_binary -> GenerationManager.submit -> task_queue -> model_worker_main -> engine.generate_image -> JobStore

response_and_errors.request_id: X-Request-ID is normalized/generated and echoed on responses

shutdown.signal_hooks: src/server.py catches SIGTERM/SIGINT and invokes manager.shutdown in finally

frozen_runtime_reference.candidate_a: frozen G6 authority; not re-run in G7
